sourceFile: 11. MSU-L20S15-07 Report test Plasma suspension A,B to check tension Fr+Sus - 2025.03.26_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable tension test evidence exists, but the draft needs corrected factor, subgroup, metric, and judgement grouping.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the plasma suspension process change.
Baseline and test conditions are left unclear despite Test vs Normal rows.
Suspension A/B should be subgroup keys under one comparison.
Spec and sample counts are misparsed; spec is 0.3 kgf with five samples per row.
Judgement ignores pass rows and final decision that plasma is same as normal.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to plasma suspension process for Frame+susp tension.
Set changed condition as Test/plasma and baseline as Normal.
Group Suspension A and B as subresults or subgroup keys.
Correct metric to tension test kgf, spec 0.3, five samples per condition.
Add cited comparison/delta/decision rows and set judgement to equivalent/pass if supported.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are citeable but incomplete; add delta and decision rows before final use.
